correctness.rationale: The quantified all-q, all-n result follows from two pigeonhole inductions yielding sharp even/odd uniform lower bounds, the exact greedy embedding cost for a periodic alphabet word, and unique run decomposition yielding the first-appearance generating function. All boundary cases including n<=q and L<2 are addressed; an independent dynamic program, exhaustive small input enumeration and coefficient recurrence passed 67,752 source-word cases and degrees through 80.

value.rationale: Determines the exact guaranteed repeated-letter run-subsequence length in every q-ary input of every length, exhibits a sharp universal periodic extremizer, and supplies a natural complete two-variable count of distinct duplicated-pattern outputs visible from that extremizer. This structural and enumerative information is not provided merely by an LLDS algorithm; it avoids arbitrary isolated parameters and has a direct interpretation as pattern recoverability after deletions.
